content: No mainstream pattern for password reset with zero email infrastructure was found; every enterprise SSPR product (Microsoft Entra, ManageEngine, LogonBox) assumes email, SMS, or an admin console as the reset channel. For a closed group of known people with no email service, the two realistic options are: (1) admin (the owner) manually resets/rotates the password out of band (Signal/text), or (2) a one-time setup link generated by the admin and shared out of band at invite time, with no self-serve 'forgot password' flow at all. Source: general SSPR vendor docs, Wikipedia (LOW confidence, no source addressed the zero-email case directly).
